notes.title: Patch 7/10
notes.notes:
We patched some things.


Hi guys, we are working at fixing the bugs you are reporting. If you find any it would be helpful if you could send the output log and a dxdiag to support@landfall.se

Stuff we did.
- Possible fix for issues when running in 144hz.
- Changing gravity in custom maps no longer affect Campaign.
- Fixed issues where custom maps would not appear for some people.
- Added "Coal" object in the editor
- Hellcano can now be selected in the editor
- "Jumping trucks" in custom maps have been fixed.
- Custom sounds and "Text Event" added to the editor

notes.title: Custom levels hotfix patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We just uploaded a patch which should hopefully solve a bunch of issues people have had with custom levels. 

Notes: 
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug where trucks in custom maps would bounce around
    [*]Fixed a bug where subscribing to a corrupted level could make it impossible to load any custom levels
    [*]Fixed a bug where the lighting would not look the same in the custom level as in the editor
    [*]Fixed a bug where some props would disappear when saving a custom level
[/list]

notes.title: Another small update
notes.notes:
Notes: 

Reworked some levels where you could reach the front of the truck hoard and had to wait.  

The last boss now only requires two green button presses to kill.  
The boss was too long for the games random nature. 
  
The patch should be live shortly

notes.title: Another small hotfix patch
notes.notes:
Notes: 

Performance and crash fixes  

Inverted Y now also works on control.  
  
Inverted X option has been added.  
 
Restart level key now also rebindable  
  
Fixed a bug where double jump could only be bound to space 


 
You might have to restart steam to get the update if you see this right when its posted.
